## 更新内容 / Changes

- 建立 Claude Code 支持基础：独立区分 Claude CLI 与 Claude Desktop，识别 Anthropic Messages 协议、Claude OAuth、API Key、Bearer 和 profile 凭据，并保留客户端、身份服务、协议和凭据类型边界。
- 增加 Claude CLI 的只读检测、版本与能力探针、实例配置投影、环境凭据清理、全局状态锁和可回收的锁占用校验。损坏锁、符号链接配置、悬空凭据链接、路径替换和不明确的登录来源都会安全失败。
- 增加独立的 Claude 会话扫描与索引模型。同一会话 ID 出现在多个文件时标记为冲突并禁止隐式恢复，Claude 会话不会进入 Codex 会话目录或复用 Codex 会话迁移逻辑。
- 增加 Anthropic 账号导入、导出、显示和备份兼容；Anthropic 凭据不会进入 OpenAI / ChatGPT Provider 用量查询、Codex 原生 `auth.json` 或 Codex 原生实例。
- Claude CLI 和 Claude Desktop 目前仍是计划接入。登录、配置、凭据隔离、全局状态、协议和会话边界完成独立验证前，不会进入实例创建向导或通用启动生命周期。

- Added the Claude Code foundation with separate Claude CLI and Claude Desktop boundaries. Anthropic Messages, Claude OAuth, API key, bearer and profile credentials retain independent client, identity-service, protocol and credential-kind metadata.
- Added read-only Claude CLI detection, version and capability probes, isolated configuration projection, inherited-credential cleanup, global-state locking and reclaim checks. Corrupt locks, linked configuration, dangling credential links, replaced paths and ambiguous login sources fail closed.
- Added an independent Claude session scanner and index model. Duplicate session IDs across files are marked as conflicts and cannot be resumed implicitly; Claude transcripts never enter the Codex session layout or reuse Codex migration logic.
- Added Anthropic account import, export, display and backup compatibility. Anthropic credentials stay out of OpenAI / ChatGPT provider usage queries, Codex native `auth.json`, and Codex native instances.
- Claude CLI and Claude Desktop remain planned integrations. They stay out of the instance wizard and common launch lifecycle until login, configuration, credential isolation, global-state, protocol and session boundaries pass independent verification.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。关闭管理器窗口不会停止运行中的实例；实例全部结束并完成配置回收后管理器才会退出。账号、实例、会话和本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。

DMG and ZIP packages are provided for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Closing the manager window does not stop running instances; the manager exits after all instances finish and their configuration is restored. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

当前支持 Codex，客户端需单独安装。Claude Code CLI 与 Claude Desktop 已建立诊断和隔离验证基础，但仍为计划功能，尚未接入实例向导或启动生命周期。Claude 的真实登录、配置、隔离、协议和会话验收完成后才会开放接入。

Codex is currently supported and must be installed separately. Claude Code CLI and Claude Desktop now have diagnostic and isolation-validation foundations, but remain planned and are not connected to the instance wizard or launch lifecycle. Claude integration will open only after real login, configuration, isolation, protocol and session acceptance is complete.

## 验证来源 / Verification

版本标签 `v0.6.0` 对应完整来源提交。GitHub Actions “Build release” 会运行公开仓库检查、macOS arm64 源码测试、打包检查并生成附件校验值。安装包校验值见附件 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。

The `v0.6.0` tag identifies the complete source commit. GitHub Actions “Build release” runs the public repository check, macOS arm64 source tests, packaging checks and installer checksum generation. Installer hashes are provided in the attached `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
